name: Verjaded
source:
An hour before anyone gets home and kicks you of the computer.
Until then you can keep looping this song, wondering if it's any good.
Until then you can keep looping your feelings, wondering if they're any good...

A story about writing a song for a guy, because you love him, even if he is a dick. What's not to love?

[Based on in-game introduction]
